gloss: the elite; picked members; crack troops

definitions.gloss: the elite; picked members; crack troops
definitions.explanation: The best and most capable people in a group, especially soldiers or team members chosen for their skill. Often used in the phrase {少数|しょうすう}{精鋭|せいえい}, a small team of picked people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{各部署|かくぶしょ}→各部署：29114_kakubusho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{精鋭|せいえい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}められた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: The best people were gathered from every department.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少数|しょうすう}→少数：05611_shousuu⟧{精鋭|せいえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: We run the project with a small team of picked people.

examples.japanese: {精鋭|せいえい}⟦{部隊|ぶたい}→部隊：28119_butai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{精鋭|せいえい}だ。
examples.english: This company has few employees, but every one of them is top-notch.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{少数|しょうすう}→少数：05611_shousuu⟧{精鋭|せいえい}: a small, elite team
- {精鋭|せいえい}⟦{部隊|ぶたい}→部隊：28119_butai⟧: elite troops, a crack unit
- {精鋭|せいえい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: to gather the best people
- {選|え}りすぐり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{精鋭|せいえい}: the hand-picked best

REGISTER:
Somewhat formal; common in news, business and sports writing. In conversation, ⟦エリート→エリート：28092_eriito⟧ or {腕利|うできき}き is more usual.
